body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. The target may stand from Prone without burning a die, then suppress one ordinary Slowed Condition until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: It becomes Rallied until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Authority - Order
rider.html: Spend this Authority when the target fails a Combat Card due to an ordinary Success Die penalty: suppress that penalty for its next card before your next turn; the failed card remains failed.
